title: PAR-134 MTEXT CMC source-method retention
scope: Retain the source R2004+ CMC method for standalone and embedded MTEXT background colors
Prevent DWG rewriting from silently changing an explicitly parsed method to a canonical C0-C3 method
Verify C0-C3 method replay, synthetic C5 observability, following-handle alignment, and fail-before-output refusal

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: ODA §2.11 defines the R2004+ CMC envelope as reserved BS index, packed BL, RC flags, and optional color/book TV strings. It does not qualify the packed payload semantics for C5 Foreground.

autodeskApi.finding: Autodesk documents ColorMethod.Foreground as 0xC5 and the ACI foreground method as 7; this supports the existing narrow scalar projection but does not establish a producer-authored DWG C5 payload.

localSource.finding: Standalone and embedded MTEXT parsed CMC through readBoundedCmColor but discarded its returned method. Their shared writer inferred C0-C3 solely from the normalized scalar/RGB fields, so a C5 source projected to scalar 7 could be rewritten as C3. DRW_MText now appends a DWG method field with a 0xFF unspecified sentinel, captures it in both parser routes, resets it on DWG reset and DXF color edits, and requires explicit C0-C3 to agree with the normalized fields before output. Unsupported explicit methods refuse before CMC emission. Pre-R2004 indexed output accepts only a representable C0/C1/C3 value without RGB or names.
localSource.compatibility: No virtual interface changed. DRW_MText public layout changes; downstream consumers must rebuild. DXF field mapping remains unchanged.

generatedControls.finding: Generated background C0-C3 cases retain explicit method identity through parse and replay. A generated C3 packed CMC method byte is changed to C5 without changing neighboring fields; production parse verifies scalar ACI 7, retained C5, and following-handle alignment. Copy, assignment, reset, and fail-before-output refusal are asserted.
generatedControls.limit: The C5 case is a synthetic mutation of a generated CMC frame, not producer-authored evidence. It qualifies only local method retention and fail-closed output behavior, not C5 payload interpretation or interoperability.

productionSummary: Retain R2004+ MTEXT background CMC method in standalone and embedded parsing.
Preserve supported explicit C0-C3 methods when they agree with scalar/RGB state.
Refuse unqualified explicit methods before writing output instead of normalizing them to C3.
Clear DWG method provenance when DXF color groups replace the public color state.
